gloss: liquid crystal display panel; LCD panel

definitions.gloss: liquid crystal display panel; LCD panel
definitions.explanation: A flat display panel that uses liquid crystals to produce images, used in televisions, monitors, smartphones, and many other electronic devices.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{液晶|えきしょう}→液晶：16387_ekishou⟧ (liquid crystal) and ⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧ (panel, from English). The term ⟦{液晶|えきしょう}→液晶：16387_ekishou⟧ itself combines ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid) and {晶|しょう} (crystal). LCD panels are found in nearly all modern flat-screen devices, and Japanese electronics companies have historically been major producers. In everyday conversation, people also say ⟦{液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}→液晶画面：08741_ekishougamen⟧ (LCD screen) to refer to the visible screen area itself.
